arguments.text: 10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) catch weed/drag (boat-model power falls vs pod power, GPS speed dips both directions) -> clear_rudder; (2) catch pod drift (pod power moves vs heart rate and boat-model power) -> set pod_gain; (3) check critical power from heart rate on steady stretches (HR climbing at steady pod power = above CP); (4) radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell. Watches: eff_ratio (boat power / pod power, normal ~0.62 at start).

arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power; drops with weed/drag or pod reading high

arguments.message: boat-model power low vs pod power: weed, drag, or pod reading high
boat-model power high vs pod: pod reading low or tailwind misfit

arguments.text: 4 min: settled after start. Pod ~203 W (pod CP 207), boat-model ~136 W (boat CP 128), ratio boat/pod ~0.67 (was ~0.63 in min 1-2). HR 166->164 flat at that effort -> near/below CP. Boat reserve 40% vs pod reserve 56%: boat model drains faster than pod. Watch whether this gap grows (pod gain or boat-model bias).

arguments.text: 5 min: measure 150-300 s (leg 1 out): pod 203 W, boat 136 W, share 0.647 (pre-race test ratio 128/207=0.62), HR 164 falling -1.2 bpm/min -> below true CP. So true boat CP likely >=136 W (computer 128 -> boat reserve wrongly draining, 34%). Next: measure leg 2 (back) to check current, then consider raising critical_power_boat_w.

arguments.name: critical_power_boat_w
arguments.evidence: Legs 1-2 (150-489 s): hull fit share of pod power reaching boat 0.68 (test implied 0.62), current ~0. HR falls at pod 203 W and rises only +0.6 bpm/min at pod 208 W, so pod CP 207 holds; 207 x 0.68 = 141 W boat.

arguments.evidence: Pod reserve 20.1 kJ x today share 0.68; test value 11.2 used a lower share.

arguments.text: 8 min: 2-leg fit share 0.68, current ~0 (push -0.01). HR: -1.2 bpm/min at pod 203, +0.6 at pod 208 -> pod CP 207 about right, pod reads true. Boat CP 128 too low (should be ~141); boat reserve wrongly heading to empty at ~9.5 min. set_belief on boat CP/reserve does NOT change the pacer (pre-race values kept). Only pod_gain changes the computer; do not fake it. Watch what the pacer does when boat reserve hits 0.
